title: devwork · tasks/<id>/gate.json — the one state file of a task: phase, goal, questions, entry_when, done_when, QA checklist, bound sessions and the next command. Only protocolo writes it.
description: harness v2 R01, R05, R22, R26. The phases are graph 1 of A5. goal, entry_when and done_when are copied from context.md by protocolo --validate-context, which also records the sha256 that freezes it; protocolo --phase refuses while context.md differs from that hash, refuses to leave discovery without entry_when and done_when, and refuses closed unless done_when exits 0. A session listed in no gate.json is not gated (A4).

phase.description: graph 1 (A5); only the owner's ! protocolo --phase moves it. continuity: the session ends and the task stays open

goal.description: context.md goal at its last --validate-context; null before it

entry_when.description: shell command, run in the task folder, that exits 0 when the work may start; required to leave discovery

done_when.description: shell command, run in the task folder; --phase closed runs it and refuses unless it exits 0

sha256.description: sha256 of context.md when the owner validated it

a.description: the answer, or the measurement with its pointer

owner.description: claude: measurable, answered by research before any AskUserQuestion (R03); user: a decision only he takes

qa.description: R26: the fixed close checklist; each value is the id of the ledger event that records the result, null while missing

sessions.description: Claude Code session ids bound by protocolo --bind

rounds.description: R03: AskUserQuestion rounds recorded by protocolo --round; gate.py denies a round at 2 or more. Optional: a gate.json written before the field reads as 0

approvals.description: R046: tool_use ids of the AskUserQuestion approvals that protocolo --phase, --validate-context and --qa have spent on a task with a bound session; an id here never approves again. Optional: a gate.json written before the field reads as none

repos.description: A10: absolute paths of the task's repos, which gate.py lets Claude write in execution. Optional; no protocolo command writes it yet

next.description: the next command, recomputed on every write
